description:
The 10AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 10ft roll is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products.

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, their products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings Nylon and Stainless-steel Braided AN Hose is universally compatible. Common uses include motor oil, gas, E85, race-fuel, and coolant. For more detail about ColorFittings AN Hose, refer here.

The 10AN diameter Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose operates at a 500PSI threshold, and boasts a 2000PSI burst threshold.

For a hassle-free installation process, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their Fitting Assembly Tools.

their Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose pairs excellently with their lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.
